examples.name: Serum IgE
examples.generalInterpretation: Total serum IgE should be interpreted with clinical findings. Elevated levels may be observed in allergic, parasitic and certain immunological conditions. A normal total IgE result does not exclude a specific allergy. Clinical correlation is recommended.
examples.clinicalNotes: Informational laboratory comment only. Requires laboratory approval before production use.

examples.name: ESR
examples.generalInterpretation: ESR is a non-specific laboratory marker and should be interpreted with clinical findings. Clinical correlation is recommended.
examples.clinicalNotes: Do not derive 2nd-hour ESR from 1st-hour ESR unless the laboratory configures a validated calculation.
